notes: בְּתוֹךְ is split here because the ASV writes both in and the midst, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet; contrast 2.33, where a single among covers the pair.
The Levite camp-phrase is appositional with no preposition in the Hebrew, so the supplied with is placed on that nominal by rule 33.
Both articles on a nomen rectum take the the standing before their own word, the construct taking a supplied one, since the ASV writes a the for each (rule 29's arthrous case).
